name: MBU deposit() price-scale mint inflation
summary: The MobiusDAO deposit proxy's deposit(token, amount) values the deposit as amount x oracle token price without dividing out the 18-decimal price scale, then mints value x 1e18 / MBU price, so it mints 1e18 times the correct MBU. A 0.001 WBNB deposit (0.657 USD at the oracle's 656.92 USD/BNB) minted 9731099570720980.659843835099042677 MBU instead of 0.00973 MBU; selling 28,500,000 of them into the MBU/USDT PancakeSwap pair drained 2,157,126 USDT. Copycats repeated the same 0.001 WBNB deposit ten more times.
notes: The proxy's first Upgraded event, log 129 of its own ERC1967Proxy creation transaction, selected implementation 0x637d8ce897bb653cb83ba436cdf76bbe158f05b1; the EIP-1967 implementation slot still reads that address at block 49470429. The next Upgraded event (the fix) is at block 49495855, after the campaign.

Gross USDT depletion of the MBU/USDT PancakeSwap V2 pair 0xb5252fcef718f8629f81f1dfcff869594ad478c6 caused by bug-minted MBU. Component 1 is the anchor transaction (attacker 0xb32a53af96f7735d47f4b76c525bd5eb02b42600). Component 2 merges later actors repeating the same deposit(WBNB, 1e15) path between blocks 49470431 and 49475087: 1809.975661133888705413 USDT drained inside seven later deposit transactions plus 634.791782021593824162 USDT from nine separate Universal Router sells by 0x89f4e21c62e0fb52c8445e842781e77fe333f50d of MBU it minted in 0x84674f8b0ac41b8870b79e51abc4ea491ebf97f02f57d45241073d7cac364dee. The 0.001 WBNB inputs are attacker-supplied and not netted; unsold bug-minted MBU and the 1,000,000 bug-minted MBU that 0xa5eabc3b36dba37593352a00ce8b7720da6fc624 staked and later unstaked are not counted. Small later pair outflows to unrelated addresses (12.01 USDT to 0x0fccab6848d59c45b758dc1c9057e618b157231f and multi-hop swaps via 0x16b9a82891338f9ba80e2d6970fdda79d1eb0dae) have unestablished MBU provenance and are excluded. Nothing was recovered.
